about: Plain-language meanings for every name in the runtime's performance file. Read by perf-report.ts (each row's `extra`), checked by perf-report.test.ts, and listed in docs/perf-glossary.md. Span and count keys are the row-name form of the runtime's probe names (lower case, dashes for colons and spaces); a family matches by start and end of that form, with {name} the part between.

datasets.synthea-10y: Synthea's realistic synthetic patient, a 10-year record of 647 records. No real person's data.
datasets.synthea-lifetime: A synthetic patient's whole life, 16,833 records: the large size, run nightly.

variants.plain: The pod's files are stored readable.
variants.encrypted: The pod's files are stored scrambled with a secret, as a person's private pod would be.

fresh-first-screen.says: A new, empty pod takes in a person's whole record and shows the first screen.
fresh-first-screen.total: Opening a new pod, importing the whole record and asking the first screen's questions: what a person waits for the first time.

reopen-first-answer.says: A pod that already holds the record is opened again and answers its first question.
reopen-first-answer.total: Opening an existing pod and answering its first read: what a returning person waits for.

question-page.says: Fetching one page of 20 answers to each of the app's questions, from the saved database.
question-page.total: Fetching one page of answers for every question in turn.

close.says: Closing a pod straight after it took in a record and drew the first screen.
close.total: Closing a pod straight after its import and first screen, which saves its database.

measures.total: The headline: the whole scenario from start to finish, the middle of three runs.
measures.import: Importing the whole record into the pod.
measures.first-screen: Asking the questions the first screen shows.
measures.first-read: The first question asked of the reopened pod ('My active conditions').
measures.second-read: A second question asked of the reopened pod ('My active medications').
measures.close: Closing the pod, saving its database.
measures.rss: Memory the process was holding when the scenario's work was done, in bytes.
measures.peak-rss: The most memory the process held at any moment, in bytes.
measures.probed-total: The scenario's time in one run with the probe on, which slows some work; its stages are from this run and are for finding where time goes, never for adding up to the headline.
measures.phase-loading-the-adapter: Import part: loading the adapter that knows this kind of record.
measures.phase-converting: Import part: converting the source record into the pod's own format.
measures.phase-saving: Import part: writing the converted records into the pod.
measures.phase-judging: Import part: judging which records are the same thing recorded twice.

scenario.close.says: Closing the pod, saving its database for the next time it opens.
